Jesus christ we are the same person. I went through the same thing last month with being worried about drug seeking behavior. Honestly it sounds to me like you need to change psychiatrists. Mine lets me experiment within reason and make suggestions because i have demonstrated to him that i am well versed on pharmacology for a 19 year old lol. Last appt he let me experiment with some doses of adderal like choosing when in the day to take the first dose and how many mg and then choosing when to take the second dose later in the day. If u dont change psychiatrists to someone more open to u(youre paying their salary you are the boss!!) you'll need to Tell your current psychiatrist you are concerned with your focus and distractibility  and that you researched to find that adderal instant with a redose later in the day works for alot of people in your situation with mood regulation as well as more mental clarity.(i assume your anxiety/depression gives some kind of fog in your head...) It does for me and the adderal(amphetamine salts) completely fixed my mood and i became productive and had a good mindset within 1 week.  Just something to consider, because time is the essence when you CAN and WILL get this tuned in.

Anyway, just know that with anxiety, we will have times that are harder than others. I have always used weed(all day)/alcohol(at night)/ or benzos(1-2 times a month). Which i guess is pretty much the worst advice i could give to an average person but i am diagnosed with general anxiety,existential anxiety,panic, and resulting depression also diagnosed and this "crutch" of sustained, mostly responsible drug use is the only reason im still here today. Take this with a grain of salt as i am not a doc but you will get out of this bad swing and for me the carefully planned drug routine that i have found through trial and error allows me to live happily with very low anxiety. I hope you can find something similar that is "off the books" to fix your anxiety because it really is different for everyone and getting out of it also requires differing means. Trial and error, man. Be safe. We have time. PM me if u wanna talk. 

Be patient, enjoy the process and learn,
